name: psicodesk
description: Sistema desktop offline-first para clínicas de psicologia

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @psicodesk/sync-protocol && npm run build --workspace @psicodesk/contracts && npm run build --workspace @psicodesk/desktop && npm run build --workspace @psicodesk/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @psicodesk/sync-protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace @psicodesk/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @psicodesk/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace @psicodesk/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @psicodesk/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:run --workspace @psicodesk/desktop && npm run test --workspace @psicodesk/sync-protocol && npm run test --workspace @psicodesk/api && npm run test --workspace @psicodesk/mobile
